description: Storybook component/story manifest connector (Tier-5 local class). Indexes the story-level metadata from a local Storybook manifest — the index.json (Storybook v7+) or legacy stories.json (v6) that `storybook build` writes to disk — as `storybook:story` items: story id, component title, story name, import path, tags, and entry type. This gives design-system component coverage and lets you recall 'which stories cover the Button component'. It is a pure filesystem read of one JSON manifest under the configured Storybook output directory: NO browser is launched, NO dev server is contacted, and NO component code is executed. The user points the connector at their Storybook output dir (e.g. storybook-static) via the non-secret path `storybook.dir`; read tools are `storybook_list`, `storybook_get`, `storybook_search`. The configured directory arrives as the scoped environment variable STORYBOOK_DIR and is added to the sandbox filesystem.read allow-list at spawn time. No network access.
author: Nimbus
